notes.title: Full version of Gravewood High now available
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

The day has finally arrived: the full version of Gravewood High is now available and the school has opened its doors to all students. Mr. Hyde cannot wait to greet each and every one of you!

Gravewood High features two large levels to explore, a wide-variety of locations, and many challenging puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/d987542a0bc0eea7b165fd6660717029bdb5c5fc.png[/img]

And the Teacher, whose powers have become even more frightening and deadly, now has a few little helpers. What are they? You'll find out in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/08724e3c64c6ea365df02c76c8274625898048f8.png[/img]

You will be able to teleport, which will, hopefully, increase your fight against the strange and mysterious evil that plagues the school. You might even survive long enough to find out just what's going on inside of the creepy school. 

We wish you all an amazing school term! Don't forget to join the school's [url=https://discord.gg/exk2UsUyaV]Discord server[/url] and tell us about your time at Gravewood High. 

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Gravewood High's full release is on May 3!
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

The School Board is pleased to announce the renovations of Gravewood High are finally finished – the school is almost ready to re-open.

We invite all students and parents to attend the opening ceremony on May 3. Our favorite teacher, Mr. Hyde, has prepared a special welcome video for all of you.

[previewyoutube=g6FT14ICmq0;full][/previewyoutube]

The dark and gloomy halls of Gravewood High and waiting for anyone brave enough to learn their secrets… and escape with their lives.

Add Gravewood High to your Wishlist, subscribe to the game's Steam page, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/exk2UsUyaV]Discord[/url] for spooky discussions about the game. 

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Changes to the Gravewood High Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

We want to make you aware of several changes to the school's development plan, which, however, won't stop you from getting the most out of your education and experience at Gravewood High. 

The long-awaited full release of Gravewood High is just around the corner! At last, you'll discover all the mysteries of the creepy school, and just who Mr. Hyde is and why he does what he does. 

We have combined two of the smaller levels into a larger one to optimize the development process, give you access to new content as soon as possible, and implement all the ideas we have for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/40e8455cff4ffa83e6e6a980b6e5c86ec23219ff.jpg[/img]

What will be in the final level of Gravewood High:
[list]
[*] A few hours of exciting and intense gameplay filled with danger and brain-blowing puzzles.
[*] Brand-new locations you haven't seen before. There will be classes, dungeons, and something else as well. 
[*] New gameplay mechanics and improvements to existing mechanics.
[*] The origin of Mr. Hyde. 
[*] The beloved Teacher will be able to teleport, break down walls, set new clever traps, and much more. 
[*] Mr. Hyde's little helpers! And no, these are not other students. Instead, they are brand-new characters in the game, getting to know them is guaranteed to cost you a few nerve cells.
[*] You can use teleportation. This feature will help you to avoid traps and the clutches of Mr. Hyde. 
[*] Two endings, which will depend entirely on your choices, so read all the notes and clues carefully. 
[/list]
The School Board promises that no student will leave Gravewood High disappointed. Mr. Hyde will personally take care of everyone and create a unique atmosphere of fun at the school. 

Add Gravewood High to your Wishlist and join our [url=https://discord.gg/exk2UsUyaV]Discord[/url] to stay tuned. Gravewood High will soon reveal its true self to the world! 

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Some important and exciting changes to Gravewood High
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents!

The School Board has prepared another mystical update for Gravewood High, and here's what awaits you. 

We've added even more content to the base version of the game that is available for free. In addition to the online co-op mode, it now includes a portion of the Gravewood High's single-player story mode. We hope you are prepared to confront the evil that lurks in the school alone. You can continue the story mode after you purchase the full version of Gravewood High.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/babd01b82417c58de083804661580bc275e48fc2.jpg[/img]

There’s also an opportunity for you to get a badge and glowing sneakers for the co-op mode. The badge will be available after buying Gravewood High – Chapter 1 DLC, and the sneakers are accessible after buying Gravewood High – Complete.

The "Gravewood High Multiplayer" Steam page will be renamed to "Gravewood High,” so don't worry if it looks a bit different.

Mr. Hyde cannot wait to meet you in the next level of the game, but you'll have to wait a little longer for that.

Subscribe to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239300/Gravewood_High/]Gravewood High Steam page[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/exk2UsUyaV]Discord server[/url], so you don't miss important announcements. 

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Update Gravewood High to access a new trap, spooky rooms, and more!
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

We have released a brand new patch for Gravewood High. Mr Hyde is waiting for you… with a new trap. Be careful not to touch the wire. If you do, the bell will ring and it will alert the Teacher.
 

When Mr. Hyde hears the bell, he will rush to the alarm and snatch up every clumsy student trying to sneak in (or out) of the school. Be sure to practice your agility and dexterity to avoid the well-placed trap.

Those of you with a keen eye would have noticed that the trap already appeared in level 1 of Gravewood High.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/3379ecec9c3e506addeee7c2a5a45ba71fec492e.png[/img]

There's also a new puzzle in the science exhibition classroom. If you can solve it, you'll gain access to a secret room, which will reveal a little more about the mystery of the spooky school.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/92dcb4a490fc776ecc7bb695011d78fc8066fd6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/98c1d42e63a84fdef0353ee41fa8e5853594b1ca.png[/img]

We've finished updating the design of the rooms on the first level. There are additional details that add to the game's atmosphere and make the environment more interesting and varied.

In addition, we've also: 
[list]
[*] Added a new secret achievement.
[*] Fixed inverted graphics settings sliders (now they work as they should).
[/list]
We are hard at work on the next Gravewood High update – have a look at our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1239300/view/3347877220449858341]Roadmap here[/url]. You won't have to wait long for it!

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZUpAZukDPu]Discord[/url] and stay tuned for future updates. After all, Mr. Hyde misses his favorite students.

See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board.

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch: Puzzle Tweaks and Fixes
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents!

We are excited to announce that the group classes at Gravewood High are getting a lot stranger. Here is what has changed with today’s update:
[olist]
[*] Fixed game crashes at launch and other random crashes. If you still get them, please send us bug reports. 
[*] New randomization for the dancefloor, library, and anatomy puzzles.
[*] New routes for the flying key.
[*] New spawning point for the players.
[*] Fixed logics for the ‘More than one’ vote 
[*] The DLC offer screen won’t show up for DLC owners. 
[*] Plant pots won’t block movement. 
[*] Small changes in effects: new poisoning indication and effects while opening prize boxes. 
[/olist]
Keep attending the group classes and bring your friends!
See you at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Board

notes.title: Bug fixes and new horror elements added!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear students and concerned parents,[/i]

We are ecstatic that everyone is enjoying the school's various activities and classes! Thank you for all of the feedback we received during Gravewood High's Early Access release. Every bit helps and we've already started implementing some of it in the form of the Bugfix update.

[h3]Here is the list of changes and tweaks:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Fixed and added FPS settings: 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, and unlimited.
[*] Added a VSync option.
[*] Expanded adjustments for gamepad and mouse sensitivity.
[*] Fixed the game displaying the "Save Settings?" message before the game resolution is changed.
[*] Increased View Distance on lower settings.
[*] Changes to the counterweight drop in the clock tower.
[*] Additional horror elements added throughout the first level.
[*] Added more randomization to some of the puzzles. For example, the one in the music classroom.
[*] Finished an optimization pass, so that the game runs even better.
[*] The duration of the hint for throwing objects with the "G" key was extended.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Teacher would get stuck in doors occasionally.
[*] Centered the light from the flashlight.
[*] Fixed a bug with the mouse control, which would get stuck occasionally when relaunching the game. You should be able to freely move the mouse vertically and horizontally now.
[/olist]

Please continue to leave any comments or bug reports in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1239300/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or on the [url=https://discord.gg/hSSQmhMXrS]official Gravewood High Discord[/url]. 

Next week, we will show how your cool ideas become a part of the class schedule!


[i]See you soon at the creepy school,
Gravewood High School Council
[/i]
